what: Merged Gate B rc12 Override can continue without writing the Step 2b.5 sentinel

what: Retained plan-review-loop caller is not covered by the proposed nonfatal rc2/rc3 plan-size contract
scenario_or_breakage: plan-review-loop.sh calls check-plan-size.sh directly under set -e. If check-plan-size returns rc2 or rc3, the loop can exit before writing the documented LOOP_STATUS handoff, while the plan says rc2/rc3 are nonfatal and preserved for retained standalone paths
suggested_fix: Add a minimal set +e capture around the plan-review-loop check-plan-size call and handle rc2/rc3 as warning-and-continue, matching the standalone Step 2b.5 diagnostic contract without changing check-plan-size.sh
